messages:
rma-bot: Automated alert: GPU7 on infra-gpu-17 has hit repeated ECC/Xid31 errors (>3 in 6h). Auto-ticket created RMA-2026-402 and added to rma-triage queue.
Maya: saw the alert — this node is in the dedicated pool video-render-rt. We're down ~7% capacity for that pool. Any local spares we can swap first?
Sam: pinging warehouse & ops team. Have the serial? I can start the vendor call if we need depot swap.
Maya: serial is GF1234567890 (from node hw inventory). Problem persists after soft-restart. Want to avoid cross-region shipping if possible.
Jordan: Vendor says warranty looks clean but they require depot-swap RMA for that S/N. Standard ETA is 5 business days for SFO depot unless we pay expedite.
Ashley: short status from logistics — SFO lab has 2 spares but both are older generation (V100/Pascal) so not compatible with this workload (we need A100 family). Amsterdam depot has an A100 spare but cross-ship customs risk.
Leo: could we temporarily route affected jobs to hosted burst capacity for 48h to avoid customer impact? Quick cost calc: 12 gpus * $4.50/hr * 48h = ~$2592 (ballpark).
Maya: that might be ok for a short window. I'd like to request vendor expedite for this RMA (cost acceptable vs customer SLA hit). Can someone open an expedite request and loop AM?
Sam: opened internal INF-RMA-317 and vendor expedite ticket EVR-17. Vendor link: https://vendor.example/rma/EVR-17 (internal). Added preferred_depot=SFO-depot-2 and flagged expedite+account-manager-cc.
Sam: adding manifest snippet to internal ticket:
```
node: infra-gpu-17
gpu_slot: GPU7
serial: GF1234567890
model: A100-80GB
issue: Xid31 recurring / ECC corrections
preferred_depot: SFO-depot-2
notes: expedite requested, SLA exception pending
```
Maya: thanks — please also add a serial reconciliation step so we don't hand out the wrong spare. Last time we had duplicates in the kitting sheet.
rma-bot: Manifest row added: https://docs.internal/rma-manifests#INF-RMA-317 ; label "expedite-cc" applied and notification sent to logistics@redwood.com.
Jordan: EngOps approved SLA exception for 72h to cover swap+validation (approved by @EngOpsLead). Please add billing hold to avoid chargebacks while we validate.
Ashley: logistics can do same-day crossdock if spare leaves SJC by 16:00 local. Need confirmation that someone can meet at SFO depot for serial handoff. Courier cost to expedite estimated $220 (one-off).
Maya: I can be at SFO depot at 15:30 and will bring spare labeling kit and the validation script key.
Leo: I'm spinning up hosted burst nodes now and migrating 12 pods off the affected node. Command I ran: `kubectl drain infra-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — migration in progress, roughly 7 mins left.
Sam: vendor just confirmed outbound AWB 1Z999SFOEXPEDIT — ETA overnight. Will update INF-RMA-317 with tracking when it hits the courier. :thumbsup:
Maya: great, thanks everyone. After swap we need a post-mortem note: root cause triage steps, why KV cache didn't catch the flake, and whether to mark this S/N as 'flake-prone' in inventory.
Ashley: noted — I'll reserve the crossdock slot and add the courier info to the manifest.
Sam: closing loop for now — INF-RMA-317 updated, vendor EVR-17 ongoing, SLA exception applied, finance looped. Will ping when tracking changes.
Maya: 👍 will follow up after physical swap and initial burn-in tests (30m validation).
